title: Application of Artificial Intelligence in Business and Management

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts and advanced applications of AI.
Apply data science techniques to solve business problems.
Utilize various machine learning methods including supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised, reinforcement learning, and deep learning.
Develop AI applications for business and management using modern frameworks and tools.
Analyze and solve complex problems using AI methodologies.
Conduct independent research on AI applications in business and management.
Work effectively in teams to develop AI solutions.
Evaluate and critique AI applications and their impact on business and management.
